definitions.exact_registry_dependent: A safe-complete interface whose validated plan consumes at least one exact registry entry.
definitions.raw_manual_contract: Pointer ABI execution is expressible, but the caller must supply listed semantic/lifetime facts or externally created pointee storage. Missing layout for caller-created readable/writable T* storage is not manual; it is blocked.
definitions.raw_metadata_complete: Every outbound ABI fact is present and expressible by the Phase 1 raw runtime.
definitions.raw_runtime_blocked: At least one inherited or declared method uses a target ABI shape rejected by the current raw runtime.
definitions.safe_complete: Existing complete safe generator succeeds for the full inherited interface.
definitions.standard_derived: A safe-complete interface whose validated plan consumes only WinMD facts and universal COM standard rules.

reason_definitions.allocator_interface_cleanup: The returned allocation is released through a known allocator-interface method rather than a Phase 1 standard cleanup wrapper.
reason_definitions.ambiguous_target_layout: More than one native layout variant applies to the target.
reason_definitions.arm64_union_by_value_gate: ARM64 by-value unions and structs containing unions remain runtime-gated.
reason_definitions.external_pointee_storage: The pointer ABI is known, but the caller must supply externally created pointee storage.
reason_definitions.incomplete_layout: A required by-value aggregate has no fields.
reason_definitions.incomplete_pointee_layout_for_storage: A writable/readable T* contract requires caller-created storage whose exact layout is unavailable or invalid.
reason_definitions.incomplete_raw_vtable: Raw methods do not cover the complete inherited compatibility method set.
reason_definitions.incomplete_union_layout: A union does not have a complete exact natural target layout.
reason_definitions.invalid_vtable_slot: Raw method slots are not contiguous from the interface root.
reason_definitions.layout_overflow: Checked native size or offset arithmetic overflowed.
reason_definitions.missing_allocator: A pointer replacement/allocation requires caller-supplied allocator knowledge.
reason_definitions.missing_count_relation: A native array lacks an authoritative count relation.
reason_definitions.missing_declaring_iid: A method's declaring interface IID is unavailable.
reason_definitions.missing_enum_underlying: An enum's exact scalar ABI is unavailable.
reason_definitions.missing_handle_ownership: A handle output is not covered by exact borrowed-handle evidence or a declared cleanup owner.
reason_definitions.missing_interface_iid: A required interface identity has no exact IID.
reason_definitions.missing_interface_replacement_contract: A typed interface InOut slot requires exact old/new ownership and replacement semantics.
reason_definitions.missing_interface_root: The interface has no supported exact IUnknown/IInspectable vtable root.
reason_definitions.missing_layout: A required by-value named type has no target layout facts.
reason_definitions.missing_output_ownership: A pointer output/replacement requires caller-supplied ownership semantics.
reason_definitions.missing_raw_methods: The complete inherited raw method list is unavailable.
reason_definitions.mixed_pointer_constness: Per-level pointer qualifiers collapse to mixed/unspecified metadata.
reason_definitions.nested_pointer_lifetime: A complete aggregate contains pointer fields whose nested lifetime/ownership remains caller-managed.
reason_definitions.non_natural_struct_layout: A raw by-value struct contains unexplained gaps, packing, or inflated tail padding.
reason_definitions.not_addressable: The identity is outside the addressable outbound Classic COM interface set.
reason_definitions.opaque_pointee_contract: The pointer width is known but the caller must supply the opaque pointee contract.
reason_definitions.pointee_missing_layout: The pointed-to aggregate has no complete metadata layout.
reason_definitions.pointee_recursive_layout: The pointed-to aggregate layout is recursively incomplete.
reason_definitions.pointee_unknown_native_type: The pointed-to aggregate contains an unknown native field type.
reason_definitions.pointee_unsupported_bitfield: The pointed-to aggregate contains a bitfield outside the Phase 1 layout subset.
reason_definitions.pointee_unsupported_flexible_array: The pointed-to aggregate contains a flexible array outside the Phase 1 layout subset.
reason_definitions.pointee_unsupported_layout_kind: The pointed-to aggregate has an unknown layout kind.
reason_definitions.pointee_unsupported_packing: The pointed-to aggregate uses packing not admitted by the current raw descriptor subset.
reason_definitions.recursive_layout: A required by-value aggregate layout is recursively incomplete.
reason_definitions.unknown_native_type: The metadata type has no exact supported native ABI identity.
reason_definitions.unknown_string_encoding: A string pointer array lacks exact encoding facts.
reason_definitions.unsupported_bitfield: Bitfield by-value layout is outside the Phase 1 raw subset.
reason_definitions.unsupported_flexible_array: Flexible-array by-value layout is outside the Phase 1 raw subset.
reason_definitions.unsupported_layout_kind: The required native layout kind is unknown.
reason_definitions.unsupported_packing: Packed/custom-packed by-value aggregates are outside the Phase 1 raw subset.
reason_definitions.unsupported_top_level_fixed_array: A bare fixed-array argument/return has no Phase 1 by-value type.
reason_definitions.variant_safearray_element_contract: A VARIANT SAFEARRAY element contract requires caller-supplied semantic interpretation.
reason_definitions.win64_irregular_aggregate_copy: Bundled libffi 3.5.2 has an irregular-size argument passing/copy defect for top-level 3/5/6/7-byte Win64 aggregates.

csv_json_cell_schemas.interface_evidence: evidence_class plus JSON arrays of standard rule IDs, exact entry IDs, exact family IDs, exact contract kinds, and metadata attributes; counts are current plan dependencies, not net contribution
csv_json_cell_schemas.layout_facts: JSON array of complete target layout fact objects
csv_json_cell_schemas.uses_constness_relations_identities: JSON object/array; RFC 4180 CSV escaping is applied by the csv crate

limitations: Outbound ABI callability only; callbacks, servers, aggregation, and cross-apartment marshaling are excluded.
Safe-complete interfaces are accepted by construction because the existing validated semantic call plan is exported from the raw entrypoint.
Lifecycle and acquisition flags are orthogonal to ABI classification and do not imply an automatic wrapper.
Direct occurrence counts cover method parameters/returns; expanded counts additionally recurse through underlying, element, and architecture-layout field types.
Safe evidence counts are dependency counts. No net-contribution claim is made without a controlled contract-family ablation.

safeEvidence.countSemantics: registeredExactEntries counts declared selector-specific entries; metadataMatchedExactEntries counts entries matched against pinned metadata; safeConsumedExactEntries counts distinct entries used by safe plans; exactEntryInterfaceDependencies counts every safe entry/interface pair; exactFamilyInterfaceDependencies counts each family once per safe interface. None is a net-contribution or ablation count.
